task: BRD-024: approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Business rules BRU-024-01 through BRU-024-17 trace to accepted ADR-024, related invariants, confirmed design choices, and existing repository contracts.
Success measures are observable and testable, while the BRD accurately states that there are no recorded selections or evidence of recommendation effectiveness.
The BRD preserves human-declared profiles, human decisions, no autonomy grant, no new storage type, and accurately separates out-of-scope work and baseline authorization.
Requirements and stakeholder measures are specific enough to guide contract-first implementation and verification.
